STEP 2 — VERIFY MERGE AND RERUN CI

PR #13 contains the validated workflow repairs.

After the owner merges PR #13:

1. Confirm PR #13 is merged into main.
2. Record the new GitHub main SHA.
3. Confirm the four repaired workflow files on main are valid YAML.
4. Trigger or verify fresh runs for:
   - IVX CI
   - IVX QA Suite
   - IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
   - Android Emulator QA
   - iOS Simulator QA
5. Wait for completion.
6. For each workflow return:
   - workflow name
   - run ID
   - source SHA
   - status
   - failed step, if any
   - exact error
7. Do not deploy yet.
8. Do not build APK yet.

SUCCESS CONDITION

- PR #13 merged
- main contains commit 341b68ce383f8432c9a399a2f1ffa2b7011c43fd or its merge commit
- all workflows parse and start
- every remaining runtime/test failure is listed individually

STOP after returning the CI results.
